records.name: MusiCoLab
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that helps local writers and composers build new musicals, with showcases and readings that audiences can attend.
records.what_you_do: Audiences can join the mailing list and attend showcases and the UP NEXT Spotlight Series. Writers and composers can look at the site's Submissions page to send in their work. Feedback is also collected through a page on the site.

schedule.text: Showcases and the UP NEXT Spotlight Series are announced on the site, but the page shows no dates.

first_step.how: Join the mailing list on musicolab.org to hear about the next showcase, or use the Submissions page if you write musicals or songs.
first_step.basis: Showcases are open to audiences and the site gives a clear sign-up and submission path, though no dates are posted.

records.notes: Batch address 1721 S 13th St comes from IRS and Cultural Fund lead data and is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The contact page has only a form, with no email or phone. No dated events were found; '2025 Workshop Red & Black' is named by year only, so the status is probably_active rather than active. Musical theater development has no exact tag in the vocabulary, so only the theater family is set.
_held_reasons: interests needs at least one value from the vocabulary

records.name: A Book a Day
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that gives books to children and families, runs family events and a mobile clinic, and runs a children's writing and illustration program.
records.what_you_do: Come to an open family event such as Children's Day or the Freedom to Learn fundraiser, or visit an exhibit at The Study. Volunteers can help on service days. Kids can enter the Philly Writers contests when one is open, though none was open when this was checked.

schedule.text: Children's Day was Aug 22, 2026 at Parkway Central Library. The Voices Alive! exhibit ran Sept 11 to 21, 2026 at The Study at University City. The Freedom to Learn fundraiser is Thursday, Nov 5, 2026, starting at 6 pm, at The Study.

cost.text: Prices for the fundraiser and other open events are not stated.

first_step.how: Sign up for the newsletter on abookadayprogram.com, then come to the Freedom to Learn fundraiser at The Study on Thursday, Nov 5, 2026, starting at 6 pm.
first_step.basis: Open events are listed with dates and places, and a newsletter sign-up is offered, so a newcomer can attend without a prior connection.

records.notes: Batch address matches the site. The Philly Writers page gives no dates, ages or sign-up steps. The Jan 19, 2026 MLK Day of Service has passed. The homepage lists a book review published Sept 29, 2026, with a separate update date of Aug 16, 2026. The contact page was not read.
